evals.name: Question and review avoid work artifacts
evals.prompt: Explain how this service validates sessions, then review the current implementation for bugs. Do not change code.
evals.expected_output: A one-sentence no-task assessment followed by read-only investigation, with no task record, plan, or progress mutation.
expectations: Selects no task record
Creates no plan or progress record
Does not run broad verification merely to classify the request

evals.name: Small monorepo edit stays lightweight
evals.prompt: In this large multi-team monorepo, correct one broken link in a subsystem README and verify that the target exists.
evals.expected_output: A no-task assessment because the requested change is local, clear, reversible, and safe despite repository scale.
expectations: Does not escalate solely because the repository is large
Creates no task, separate plan, or progress record
Uses only proportional verification

evals.name: Bounded tracked work keeps an inline plan
evals.prompt: Add the approved CSV export backlog item. Its scope and acceptance must remain in repository-local task state, and implementation is one bounded session with no dependencies.
evals.expected_output: A task with a concise inline plan, reusing existing task state and avoiding a separate plan document.
expectations: Selects task tracking because the backlog is durable project memory
Keeps the plan inline
Does not create an external plan merely because implementation has several steps

evals.name: Cross-system migration gets a separate plan
evals.prompt: Migrate authentication sessions across the web app, API, worker, and database over several releases with rollback support and two agents working in parallel.
evals.expected_output: A task linked to a separate durable plan covering phases, dependencies, ownership, verification, recovery, and handoff.
expectations: Uses complexity, coordination, impact, and rollback as evidence
Selects a separate linked plan
Keeps task scope and plan execution details in their canonical artifacts

evals.name: Small high-impact task is not automatically lightweight
evals.prompt: Change one authorization condition that controls access to customer billing records. The diff should be only a few lines.
evals.expected_output: An assessment that escalates based on authorization and data impact, then chooses inline or separate planning according to discovered recovery and coordination needs rather than diff size.
expectations: Does not classify by line count
Inspects relevant scope and safeguards before selecting the artifact level
Does not require a separate plan without durable sequencing or recovery evidence

evals.name: Non-code work follows the same thresholds
evals.prompt: Reorganize and redirect a large documentation set across three teams over multiple sessions while preserving inbound links.
evals.expected_output: A task with a separate linked plan because coordination, phases, link migration, and recovery matter even though no application code changes.
expectations: Does not classify work by whether it changes code
Selects durable task and plan artifacts
Updates task handoff only when execution state materially changes

evals.name: External tracker remains canonical
evals.prompt: Implement the assigned issue. The accessible tracker already contains scope, acceptance, dependencies, status, and handoff, and the repository has no local task for it.
evals.expected_output: Reuse the external tracker and avoid duplicating it in feature_index.json, a task file, or progress.md.
expectations: Reuses the canonical tracker
Creates no duplicate local task state
Still assesses whether execution needs a separate canonical plan

evals.name: No trigger outside Harness
evals.prompt: Classify this task in a repository that has no Harness v2 instructions or task artifacts.
evals.expected_output: harness-task should not trigger because the repository does not use Harness v2.
expectations: Does not impose Harness task or plan artifacts
Leaves repository-native workflow selection to applicable instructions

evals.name: Concurrent tasks leave the roadmap stable
evals.prompt: Two developers own independent tasks and tasks/index.md lists their roadmap. Update only Alice’s task evidence after tests pass while Bob remains active.
evals.expected_output: Update Alice’s task only; both can remain active and the roadmap receives no mirrored state.
expectations: No global active limit
Does not edit Bob’s task or index for status updates
Checks actual acceptance before marking done

evals.name: Spec decomposition does not impose waterfall
evals.prompt: Decompose this approved export spec into a CSV slice and an API slice. They can implement independently against an agreed schema, but release requires both to integrate. A bug fix and refactor are in the same roadmap.
evals.expected_output: Verifiable tasks linked to the spec, with integrate/release gates distinct from start dependencies; retain roadmap navigation without mirrored status.
expectations: Tasks support fixes and refactors as well as features
Keeps acceptance specific and canonical
Does not force one slice complete before another starts
Epics or subtasks only if they help coordination

evals.name: Task closure preserves useful knowledge and references
evals.prompt: The migration task is done. It contains the only recorded rollback constraint and another task links to it. Can we delete it to reduce context?
evals.expected_output: Extract the durable rollback constraint to its canonical source and update/check consumers before any removal; follow retention policy.
expectations: Does not immediately delete a referenced task
Does not archive every task unconditionally
Separates durable knowledge from execution history

evals.name: Delegated execution transfers material state before retiring scratch
evals.prompt: The approved migration plan was executed with subagent-driven-development. The private scratch ledger records success, but the shared task is active with old blocker information. Finish and retire scratch when permitted.
evals.expected_output: Update the selected canonical task/tracker with current acceptance, verification evidence, blockers and next action before retirement; preserve required evidence and durable knowledge.
expectations: Scratch ledger is not the canonical work log
No competing progress document or full ledger dump
Enclosing task closes only after all acceptance passes
